artworks.title: Portrait of Harness Makers
artworks.description: This is a photograph of two individuals inside a workspace. The scene is set in a workshop or a smithy with tools, such as tongs, and leather straps or harnesses hanging on the wall. The individuals are engaged in sorting or examining the equipment. They are dressed in work clothes, wearing hats and aprons. One individual is holding a tool, possibly making adjustments to a piece of equipment. The photograph has a sepia tone, emphasizing the historical context.

artworks.title: Portrait of Roofers
artworks.description: Two men are sitting on the roof of a brick building. One man is on the left side and the other on the right, both with their legs hanging over the edge. The man on the left is wearing a wide-brimmed hat, a light-colored shirt, and pants. The man on the right is also wearing a hat, a light shirt with suspenders, and has facial hair. Around them are chimney stacks, a basket, and various tools. In the background, there is a blurry view of rooftops and trees. The lower foreground shows a brick wall of the building and some windows.

artworks.title: Coverlet and Carpet Weaving
artworks.description: Three men are standing outside a brick building with a sign that reads "COVERLET & CARPET WEAVING." The man in the center is dressed formally in a dark suit and long coat, holding a hat. The other two men are wearing vests over light-colored shirts and hats, with one appearing to hold a bundle of woven goods. The setting is industrial or commercial, with stacked goods and an unpaved ground surface. The background includes the brick building with shuttered windows and a wooden gate nearby.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Bottle Corker
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on a patterned rectangular object. He is facing the camera, with his legs relaxed and apart. He has a beard and mustache, with short hair combed to the side. The man is wearing a buttoned vest over a shirt with rolled-up sleeves, loose-fitting trousers, and boots. He is holding a mallet in his left hand and a tool in his right hand, which is resting on the object. The background is plain, and the floor has a geometric pattern.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Print Colorist
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting in a chair and painting at an easel. He is in profile, holding a paintbrush to the canvas. The man's hair is neatly combed, and he wears a dark, formal suit. He holds a palette in his left hand and an open carrying case is beside him. The background is a textured wall with an ornate carpet on the floor.

artworks.title: Charles F. Hanson, Piano Forte Tuner and Repairer
artworks.description: The image displays a man seated on a cushioned stool, facing sideways at a grand piano. He is engaging with the piano, with one hand on the keys and the other holding a tuning tool. The man has neatly combed hair, a mustache, and sideburns, and is wearing a dark suit jacket over a light-colored waistcoat and trousers, with a white shirt and a tie. An open tool case with various tools is on the floor beside him. The background is a simple, undecorated wall.

artworks.title: A. W. Porter, Wilcox & Gibb’s Sewing Machine Agent
artworks.description: The image displays a man working at an ornate sewing machine. He is seated in profile, focusing on the fabric in front of him. The man has a beard and mustache, neatly groomed hair, and is dressed in a dark suit with a white shirt. He sits on a simple chair in front of a plain, textured background indoors.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Fireman
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with a long-handled axe. He has dark curly hair, a mustache, and is wearing a uniform with the number "8" on the chest. He has one hand on his hip and the other resting on the axe handle. He is wearing a tall helmet-style hat with an emblem at the front. The man's feet are crossed at the ankle. In the background, there is a painted backdrop with architectural designs and a vague landscape with distant trees.

artworks.title: Andrew and Billie, Furniture Movers
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing and holding a chair horizontally between them. The man on the left wears a dark coat, light trousers, and boots, with a beard and mustache. The man on the right wears a light-colored shirt with suspenders and a cap, with light-colored hair. They are both holding a wooden slat-back chair, and the background is a plain studio wall with a wooden floor.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Tailor
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated cross-legged on a patterned surface that could be a table or platform covered with floral fabric. The man's full body is visible from the waist up to his head, with his legs tucked beneath him. He has a full beard and mustache, with short, neatly trimmed hair, and is wearing a round, flat-brimmed hat. His facial features are prominent and he has a focused expression. He is dressed in a white shirt with a high collar, a vest, and pants that are slightly wrinkled. The man is holding a long, thin tool or object in his hands. To his left, there is a large, heavy apparatus with a handle. The background is plain and worn, suggesting either an aged wall or a backdrop.

artworks.title: Portrait of Telegraphers
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color (carte-de-visite)
artworks.description: The image shows two men sitting at a table, with their bodies visible from the waist up. The man on the left is seated on a chair, looking directly at the viewer, and is holding a book or a small stack of papers. He has a clean-shaven face and short, combed-back hair. He is wearing a dark suit with a high-collared white shirt underneath, and his hat is placed on the table beside him. The man on the right is also seated and looks slightly to the side. He has a full beard and mustache, and his hair is somewhat obscured by a wide-brimmed hat. He is dressed in a dark jacket with white piping over a light shirt and holds a similar object to the first man. On the table in front of them are two devices that appear to be related to recording or printing. The background of the image is plain and unadorned, with a uniform tone that serves as a neutral backdrop for the subjects.

artworks.title: Steam Engine Factory
artworks.description: The image shows a group of about twenty men gathered around a piece of machinery mounted on wheels, likely a fire engine. The men are mostly standing, with some seated or leaning on the equipment. Most of their bodies are visible, with a few only showing from the waist up. The men are dressed in typical working men's attire of the period, including vests, button-up shirts, and trousers, with some wearing brimmed hats. Facial features of the individuals are indistinct due to the image quality, but some appear to have mustaches or beards. A few individuals are also seen in the windows of a brick building in the background, which has several windows and a door. The background includes the brick building, possibly a fire station or factory, and a wooden fence on the far left, suggesting an industrial setting.

artworks.title: Charles Ketterer with his Apostolic Clock
artworks.description: The image shows a man from head to toe standing next to a large, intricately detailed structure. He is standing upright with his right hand resting on the structure and his left hand holding a small bird. The man has a full beard and mustache, and his hair is neatly combed back. He is dressed in a suit with a waistcoat and a bow tie. The structure beside him is ornately decorated, featuring carvings and figures, including small sculptures of animals and humans, with the top adorned by a complex arrangement of motifs and a crow or similar bird figure. The structure is labeled "THE APOSTOLIC EXCELSIOR" with smaller figures labeled "MOSES" and "ELIAS" nearby. It appears to have a grid-like base and is quite tall, standing almost as high as the man. The background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Leather Worker
artworks.description: The image features a man from the waist up, seated and facing the camera. He is holding a long, curved object and appears to be engaged in a task. The man has a strong jawline, a well-defined mustache, and dark, neatly combed hair. He is wearing a light-colored shirt with rolled-up sleeves under a pinstriped apron and a thin tie around his neck. The setting has a plain background suggesting a studio portrait, and the picture is enclosed in an ornate frame with floral patterns.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Shoemaker
artworks.description: The image displays a man seated in a straightforward posture. He has short, neatly combed hair and a serious facial expression. He is wearing a high-collared shirt with rolled-up sleeves and a dark-colored apron over it, reaching his knees. In his hands, he holds a shoe and a hammer-like tool. The background is plain with a backdrop that seems to be a simple wall or sheet.

artworks.title: Portrait of Leather Dyer
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright. He is facing forward, with his left hand on his hip and his right hand holding a long wooden oar vertically. He has a full beard and mustache, and is wearing a wide-brimmed straw hat. He is dressed in a checkered shirt with short sleeves, a dark apron, dark pants, and shoes. The background features a painted scene of trees and a landscape, and the wooden floor is visible beneath him.

artworks.title: Portrait of Mechanics
artworks.description: The image depicts two men standing side by side, each holding large metal wrenches vertically in front of them. Both men are shown from head to toe on a surface covered with straw or hay. The man on the left has facial hair that includes a mustache and a goatee, and he is wearing a brimmed cap, a buttoned jacket or work shirt, and overalls. The man on the right also has facial hair, with a full mustache and slight beard, wearing a cap, a buttoned shirt or work jacket, and overalls. Both men have their hands wrapped around the top handle of their tools. The background is plain and neutral without any additional details.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Blacksmith
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright. He has a moustache and is wearing a straw hat, a plaid shirt, a vest, and an apron. He is holding a hammer in his right hand and a horseshoe in his left hand. In the background, there is a dark draped fabric and a chair. The photo is framed with a decorative border with red designs and patterns.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Lumberjack
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing holding an ax and a pipe in his mouth. He has a mustache and wears a bowler hat, a striped shirt, suspenders, and pinstripe pants. The man stands on a textured surface with a painted background of a wooden fence, foliage, and flowers on a wooden post.

artworks.title: Portrait of Tailors
artworks.description: The image shows four men, all seen in a full-length view. Three of them are standing, while one is seated in front of the group. Each man is wearing a dark vest over a long-sleeved white shirt, with a bow tie and a wide-brimmed hat. The standing men have short, tidy hairstyles, while the seated man has a similar hairstyle with a neat mustache. The man on the left has a pocket watch chain visible and is resting his arm on a sewing machine. The man in the middle holds a boot in his hand, and the seated man has fabric draped over his knee. The man on the far right is holding a small box in his hand. In the background, there is an ornately decorated wall, with the upper portions showcasing intricate patterns. On the side, shelves lined with various items are visible, creating the appearance of a workshop or store. The floor features a geometric patterned tile.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Shoe Salesman
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on a wooden chair with one leg crossed over the other and holding an object in his lap. He has short hair, a mustache, and wears a bowler hat, a dark jacket, a vest, a white shirt, and dark trousers. Next to him is a round table with boots and a hat, against an ornately decorated wall and a patterned floor. The photograph is framed in pink with decorative designs and the number "73" at the top.

artworks.title: Portrait of Furniture Upholsterers
artworks.description: The image shows three standing men from the thighs up, positioned side by side and looking towards the camera. The man on the left has a narrow face with a defined jawline, the man in the middle has a slender face, and the man on the right appears younger with a softer, rounder facial structure. They are wearing caps, striped aprons, plain shirts with rolled-up sleeves, and vests. In front of them are intricately patterned upholstered pieces of furniture, like a padded armrest and a cushion. The background displays walls with faint decorative designs, suggesting an indoor setting, possibly a workshop or showroom.

artworks.title: Portrait of an Ice Man
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing upright and facing the camera straight on. He has a mustache and wavy hair, wearing a brimmed hat, button-up jacket, trousers, knee-high boots, and holding tongs with ice blocks in each hand. The background is plain.
